description: An engineering change as the system that owns it names it (a change notice in PLM, a change number in SAP ECM): the bracket that ties the revisions of PLM and ERP together. Not the model's own change request (SMProfile-ChangeRequest).

properties.name: change_id
properties.description: Identity of the change as the source names it (e.g. the SAP change number or the PLM change notice number).

properties.name: description
properties.description: What the change is, as the source says it.

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: From when the change is valid, as the source states it.

properties.name: status
properties.description: The state of the change in its source, in the source's own words.

isa95.mappingNote: B2MML 0701 has no engineering change object; definitions carry only a Version and effectivity dates. An extension (PLAN-0700 L6, owner 29.10.2026). status keeps the source's words: the lifecycle of a change differs per PLM / ERP and no list is invented.
